==Dialogue==
{{dialogue needed}}
:''"Is your guild in need of a guild hall? You have come to the right place! By the authority of the Emperor of Canthan and the illustrious Celestial Ministry, I am permitted to grant any worthy guild an island complete with a ready-made guild hall.

:''What would you like to discuss?"''

:'''⇒ I have a few questions.'''

::''"I am more than happy to answer your questions."''

::'''⇒ Why should I deal with the Canthans?'''

:::In [[Lion's Arch]]:
:::''"You will not be granted a guild hall anywhere on the mainland. After the devastation of the Guild Wars, both Kryta and Ascalon banned guilds from owning land. No, if you desire a guild hall, you must petition for territory on one of the Canthan islands to the south."''

:::In [[Kaineng Center]]:
:::''"You will not be granted a guild hall anywhere on the mainland, but you can petition me for territory on one of the many islands controlled by Cantha."''

:::In [[Kamadan, Jewel of Istan]]:
:::''"You will not be granted a guild hall anywhere on the mainland, but you can petition me for territory on one of the many islands controlled by Cantha."''

:::'''⇒ Will my petition be granted?'''

::::''"A guild must have a recognized emblem or it cannot be considered a reputable guild. I will also require some sign that the heavens favor your endeavors. Bring me a [[Celestial Sigil]] as a sign that you are favored."''

::::'''⇒ How do I get an emblem?'''

:::::If you have a guild cape:
:::::''"You have one already! No doubt it matches the emblem that is on your cape."''

:::::'''⇒ What was that about a Celestial Sigil?'''

::::::''"It is said the Celestial Sigil is granted to those brave and skillful enough to hold the Hall of Heroes and earn the blessings of the gods.''

::::::''To reach the Hall of Heroes, well, legends hold that you must pass through the underworld itself. The Zaishen Guild of the Great Temple of Balthazar contend that they know of a place, Heroes' Ascent, that can be used to start such a journey."''

::::::'''⇒ What about a guild banner?'''

:::::::Returns you to "How do I get an emblem?"

::::::'''⇒ Let's talk about something else.'''

:::::::Same as "I have a few questions."

:::::'''⇒ Let's talk about something else.'''

::::::Same as "I have a few questions."

::::'''⇒ Where can I find a Celestial Sigil?'''

:::::Same as "What was that about a Celestial Sigil?"

::::'''⇒ Why should I go to all this trouble?'''

:::::Same as "Why should I deal with the Canthans?"

:::'''* I'm interested in a guild hall.'''

::::Same as "What islands can you show me?"

:::'''× I've heard enough.'''

::'''⇒ Will my guild be deemed worthy?'''

:::Same as "Will my petition be granted?"

:'''⇒ What islands can you show me?'''

::''"I am pleased that you should ask. Truly, what guild can call itself a guild without an island of its own?''

::''Come with me. I can take you on a tour of each island, and you can choose which you like the best."''
